{
  "description": "Cloud Custodian (c7n) is an open-source rules engine for managing public cloud accounts and resources. It allows users to define policies in YAML to query, filter, and take actions on resources across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and other providers. It focuses on security compliance, cost optimization, and governance through automated policy enforcement (e.g., tagging, encryption, resource termination).",
  "version": "0.9.53",
  "capabilities": [
    {
      "name": "Authentication & Authorization",
      "capability_id": "CAP.SEC.AUTH",
      "coverage": "none",
      "evidence_status": "unknown",
      "confidence": 0.1,
      "evidence_refs": [],
      "notes": "Cloud Custodian consumes cloud provider credentials (AWS IAM Roles, Azure Service Principals, GCP Service Accounts) to execute policies against cloud resources. It does not provide its own user authentication, identity management, or authorization service for end-users accessing the tool itself. It relies entirely on the underlying cloud provider's IAM."
    },
    {
      "name": "Policy Definition & Management",
      "capability_id": null,
      "coverage": "full",
      "evidence_status": "verified",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "evidence_refs": [
        "README.md@c734fdb2",
        "c7n/policy.py@c734fdb2"
      ],
      "notes": "Core capability. Supports YAML-based policy definitions with filters and actions for various cloud resources."
    },
    {
      "name": "Cloud Resource Governance & Compliance",
      "capability_id": null,
      "coverage": "full",
      "evidence_status": "verified",
      "confidence": 0.95,
      "evidence_refs": [
        "README.md@c734fdb2"
      ],
      "notes": "Enforces security policies (encryption, access requirements), tag policies, and cost management via garbage collection."
    },
    {
      "name": "Multi-Cloud Support",
      "capability_id": null,
      "coverage": "full",
      "evidence_status": "verified",
      "confidence": 0.9,
      "evidence_refs": [
        "README.md@c734fdb2",
        "pyproject.toml@c734fdb2"
      ],
      "notes": "Explicitly supports AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, OpenStack, OCI, and Tencent Cloud via modular providers."
    },
    {
      "name": "Serverless Event-Driven Execution",
      "capability_id": null,
      "coverage": "partial",
      "evidence_status": "verified",
      "confidence": 0.85,
      "evidence_refs": [
        "README.md@c734fdb2"
      ],
      "notes": "Supports running policies via serverless functions (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions) triggered by cloud events (CloudWatch Events, EventGrid, Pub/Sub)."
    }
  ],
  "interfaces_detail": [],
  "dependencies": [
    "boto3",
    "cryptography",
    "jsonschema",
    "pyyaml",
    "python-dateutil",
    "tabulate",
    "urllib3"
  ],
  "runtime": [
    "Python >=3.10.2, <4.0.0"
  ],
  "deployment_constraints": [
    "Requires valid cloud provider credentials (IAM roles, service accounts) to function",
    "Docker image available based on Ubuntu 24.04",
    "Can run as cron job or serverless function"
  ],
  "maturity": "stable",
  "adaptation_hours_estimate": 40,
  "adaptation_confidence": "low",
  "adaptation_assumptions": [
    "The target component requires a custom configuration service with user/role management, which is not present in Custodian.",
    "MQTT distribution interface must be built from scratch as Custodian uses cloud-native event buses or CLI/API.",
    "Geofence definitions are not natively supported; would require custom resource types and filters."
  ],
  "known_gaps": [
    "No native user authentication/authorization system",
    "No native role-based access control (RBAC) for tool users",
    "No MQTT support for configuration distribution",
    "No built-in geofence definition management",
    "No local database or persistent state store for policies (relies on cloud storage/filesystem)"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "License: Apache 2.0 is permissive but requires attribution.",
    "Maintenance: Large project with many dependencies; updates may require significant testing.",
    "Security: Relies on cloud provider IAM; misconfiguration of policies can lead to unintended resource actions."
  ],
  "evidence": [
    {
      "claim": "Cloud Custodian is a rules engine for managing public cloud accounts and resources using YAML policies.",
      "source_ref": "README.md@c734fdb2",
      "verified": true
    },
    {
      "claim": "Version 0.9.53 defined in pyproject.toml.",
      "source_ref": "pyproject.toml@c734fdb2",
      "verified": true
    },
    {
      "claim": "Supports AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, OpenStack, OCI, Tencent Cloud.",
      "source_ref": "README.md@c734fdb2",
      "verified": true
    },
    {
      "claim": "Policy loading and validation logic exists in c7n/policy.py.",
      "source_ref": "c7n/policy.py@c734fdb2",
      "verified": true
    }
  ]
}
